Full Encyclopedia of Fantasy (1997) entry 'Twain, Mark' (by GF) rendered despite the http_error status; a critical essay on the fantastic elements in his fiction with dated work titles. No birth/death specifics beyond years.

extraction_notes.notes: Koha MARC view (UNIMARC) of authority 148: only a 200 heading 'Twain, Mark, 1835-1910', used in 33 records. Nothing else in the record.

Koha OPAC MARC view of University of Macedonia (Thessaloniki) Library authority 78439, a copy of the LC NAF record n 79021164 for Twain, Mark, 1835-1910, used in 7 records. Fully visible; includes 400 variants, 500 links to Clemens/Snodgrass/Conte and 670 source notes.

AniList staff page for Mark Twain: alternative names (incl. Japanese), birth/death, age 74, gender, 'Years active: 1863-1910' (no schema slot, kept here), hometown, a short English bio, and anime/manga adaptations credited to him as original creator/story.

Listal community person page for Mark Twain: a short stats box (birth name, dates, country, height, partner), a one-paragraph bio, user tags, and top-5 lists of books, films and TV based on his work; the rest is user lists and an activity feed. An 'IMDB profile' link is shown without its URL.

Autoritats UB authority record: heading, many 'Emprat per' (see-from) variant forms, related names (the Clemens real-name record and the pseudonyms Louis de Conte and Quintus Curtius Snodgrass), and the source LC/NAF. VIAF is shown as a link label without a URL in the text.

A Rodovid genealogy record (Person:231947) for Samuel Langhorne Clemens. It lists sex, birth name, his other name Mark Twain, birth and death events with places, his parents, siblings, wife, children, son-in-law and granddaughter. Some values are in Russian, such as 'США' and 'Осип Габрилович'.

NUKAT (Polish union catalogue) Koha authority search results page with exactly 1 hit: the authorized personal heading Twain, Mark (1835-1910), control number n 94200767, with its see-from references and 932 linked records. Only the summary row is shown, not the full record.
Dutch WikiKids (children's wiki) article: an intro with name, dates and places, and a paragraph on Tom Sawyer / Huckleberry Finn. Other-language links are given as names only.

National Library of China OPAC cross-reference display for 'Mark Twain (1835-1910)'. The captured text is browser-translated from Chinese into English (Chinese-script headings appear as English or pinyin; 'Tomato, Malik' is a mistranslation of an Arabic-script form). Note: the system number shown is 000067270, while the URL's acc_sequence is 000205309.

Two IBDB person pages, 11201 'Mark Twain' and 13531 'Samuel Clemens', each cross-referencing the other as 'Also Known As'; both list the same Broadway credits as source-material writer. Only 11201 gives birth/death places.

ISFDB summary bibliography for Mark Twain (author record #160). It shows the legal name, birth and death data, language, alternate names and tags, followed by a long genre and non-genre work list with translations. The webpages row names external sites without showing their URLs.

A short Catalan encyclopedia article on Mark Twain in the Gran Enciclopèdia Catalana. It gives birth and death places and dates and a paragraph on his works, with a photo credited to FOTOTECA.CAT. Some of its work dates differ from the standard dates (Huckleberry Finn 1882, Pudd'nhead Wilson 1884).

Danish bibliography page (Udenlandske forfattere til oversat skønlitteratur indtil 1975) for Samuel Langhorne Clemens / Mark Twain: a short header (name, dates, language, pseudonym, note) followed by a very long chronological list of Danish translations 1873-1975 (books, anthology contributions, contents), with a per-year production chart and a list of dramatic performances in Danish theatres. Links to 'International forfatterbibliografi' and Danish Wikipedia are shown as link text only, without URLs. Read via grep around hits (file ~315 KB).

A Koha MARC view of the Universidad de Cádiz authority record 15651 for Twain, Mark, 1835-1910, used in 34 records. It is a minimal record: a heading, three see-from variants and the source BNE. A cookie banner appears at the top, but the record was not hidden behind a login wall.

Lib.ru/Klassika author page for Mark Twain: a short 'about the author' line, life dates, places lived, and a long list of free Russian translations (novels, stories, humorous sketches) with their English originals, plus critical writings about him. Left sidebar genre counts and 'today we celebrate' list are site chrome.
CONOR.SI (Slovenian COBISS) authority record: heading, variant names including real-name forms, country, language, a note 'Ameriški pisatelj in humorist', and the CONOR.SI-ID.

French Vikidia (children's encyclopedia) article with an infobox (official name, birth/death dates and places, nationality, profession), a two-paragraph intro and a list of works. Interwiki links to other projects are listed by name only, without URLs.

enciclopedia.cat article 'Mark Twain' in Catalan: birth/death places and dates, real name, and a paragraph on his life and works. Some dates in the text are as given by the source (e.g. Huckleberry Finn 1882, Pudd'nhead Wilson 1884).

Koha OPAC MARC view of authority 58014 'Twain, Mark,' (copy of the LC NAF record with Spanish field labels). Full record visible despite the suspected login wall (only a cookie banner and login link in the chrome). Rich: 046 dates, 370 places, 372/374 fields and occupations, 400 script variants, 500 pseudonym links, 663 and 670 sources.

Trove People & Organisations record 'Twain, Mark (1835-1910)' contributed by Libraries Australia: 670-style source data, a long 'Also known as' list in many scripts, persistent identifiers, and see-also links to Clemens, Louis de Conte and Quintus Curtius Snodgrass identities. Shows 1372 resources by and 1391 about.
Pontifical Gregorian University (Osee Genius) authority record shown as raw MARC: only the heading 'Twain, Mark, 1835-1910', control fields and a 996 local link. No variants, sources or bio.

VIAF 'processed' view of the Croatian National and University Library (NSK) MARC authority record 000047578 for Twain, Mark, with VIAF-added derived fields (9xx: works, co-authors, publishers, languages, 998 cluster matches, 996 non-clustered candidates, 999 NSK bib record ids). The 996 list (other VIAF candidate records not merged) and the 950/955 co-author lists are not treated as same_as/related data about him.

Sancho el Sabio Foundation catalogue authority page: personal name heading 'Twain, Mark' plus a Spanish biography quoted from Spanish Wikipedia, with a citation and a 'Ver en Wikipedia' link. Links to the MARC view and related documents are present but their content is not in the text.

Enciclopédia Açoriana entry 'Twain, Mark' (Portuguese), by Ricardo Manuel Madruga da Costa, focused on his 1867 Quaker City stop at Horta, Faial, described in The Innocents Abroad; includes a bibliography. Gives the death date as 2.4.1910, which conflicts with the usual 21 April 1910.

Two ObalkyKnih.cz author pages keyed by Czech National Library authority ids: jn19981002263 (Twain, Mark) with the NKC biographical note and an English Wikipedia-style bio, and jn20000701083 (pseudonym record Conte, Louis de) showing only name and dates. No work list or cover images are present in the captured text.

Darwin Correspondence Project name-register entry: name, dates, a one-line description and its source (ANB). Almost all of the text is site navigation; the entry notes there is no associated correspondence.

Encyclopedia of China (3rd ed., zgbk.com) article 马克·吐温 in the Foreign Literature section, by 周珏良. The article body and infobox values are rendered in an obfuscated font, so the extracted text is unreadable glyph noise; only the heading, English name, dates, author, update date and the readable sidebar lists are usable. Page notes the title has 3 senses (外国文学 / 中外儿童文学交流互鉴 / 北美洲).

Minimal Koha MARC-view authority record 137048 at the Pontifical Urban University Library: heading 'Twain, Mark, 1835-1910' and a single 670 citing a Melville 'Moby Dick' catalogue record (oddly, a work by another author). No variants, links or bio.

At the Circulating Library (Victorian fiction database) author record: name with dates, alternate names, one-line biography, author tags, reference source and 11 British editions of his fiction. The alternate-name line shows '(pseudonym)' with the pseudonym text itself missing.
The BBC returned '404 Not Found' for this BBC Things URL, apparently because the service was retired. The page shows only BBC navigation and footer, with no data about the entity.

The full view of authority record 000034587 in the Chilean union authority catalogue (Biblioteca Nacional de Chile). It gives the established heading Twain, Mark, 1835-1910, many non-used forms (transliterations and the pseudonym Alden, Jean Francois), sources, a one-line biography and an LCCN link.

A LibriVox author page for Mark Twain (1835 - 1910) with a short Wikipedia-style bio and a 'Wiki - Mark Twain' link. The page reports 270 matching recordings, but the work list itself was not rendered in the captured text.

BiblioNet (Greek books in print) person page: heading 'Twain, Mark, 1835-1910', a Greek-language biography paragraph, then a long list of Greek editions of his works with publisher, ISBN and year. No external links or identifiers shown in the text.

extraction_notes.notes: NILF (Italian catalogue of fantastic literature) author page for Mark Twain: nationality, language, life dates, alternate names and a list of his fantastic works in Italian translation with original titles and edition counts. 'Dixon Wecter' is listed under 'Noto anche come', which is an error (Wecter was an editor), recorded as given.

BabelNet synset page bn:00019709n (Named Entity) for Mark Twain: lexicalisations, glosses from WordNet/Wikipedia/Wikidata, and a relations block mirroring Wikidata statements. Over 90% of the text is repeated language-selector menus; the record itself is a short block near line 1205-1916.

filmportal.de person page (English UI, machine-translated film titles) for Mark Twain with role 'script', dates/places and a filmography of German film adaptations credited as 'Template' (Vorlage = source material). Oddities: real names are labelled '(pseudonym)', and the death date is printed as 'February 21, 1910' (Twain died 21 April 1910). A 'Person Authority Record (GND)' external link is shown as a label only, no URI in the text.

BnF catalogue général person authority 'Twain, Mark (1835-1910) pseudonyme' in public format: country, language, sex, birth/death with places, short note, rejected form, sources (incl. LC link), ISNI, ark and creation/update dates; 823 linked records as author, 245 as subject.

Lord Byron and his Times person record 'Mark Twain (1835-1910)': name authorities block (LOC heading, LBT/VIAF/LOC ids), birth/death dates, sources and a one-line description. References to person/works are only link labels.

The legacy RERO URL resolves to VIAF's 'processed' MARC view of the RERO authority record A000164542 (Twain, Mark, 1835-1910), not to a RERO page. It holds the RERO heading, see-from pseudonyms, two 680 notes, VIAF-derived work titles (910/912), co-authors (950) and the list of matched source records in the VIAF cluster (998); 996 rows are other non-merged clusters and are not extracted. Ids are given as SOURCE|id strings, not URIs.

Project Runeberg 'Nordic Authors' page for Mark Twain: one-line description, list of Scandinavian translations published on Runeberg, Swedish life dates line, a translator note, and links to encyclopedia articles, Wikipedias, Gutenberg, Libris etc. (link targets not shown in text).

Nationalencyklopedin (Sweden) long-form article 'Mark Twain', truncated behind a paywall after the opening paragraph, plus a cross-reference stub 'Samuel Clemens' pointing to the pseudonym Mark Twain. 'Läs även om' sidebar entries (Singer, Steinbeck, Disney...) are unrelated and ignored, except the Tom Sawyer / Huckleberry Finn entries that mention Twain.

Two Koha MARC-view authority records despite the login_wall flag: A069925 (old 122385) for the real person 'Clemens, Samuel Langhorne, 1835-1910' with VIAF/ISNI/LCCN links, occupations and 670 sources; and A111227 (old 178278) for the pseudonym identity 'Twain, Mark, 1835-1910' with Greek variant names. The two are cross-linked via 500 fields.

There are four full-view authority records from the Biblioteca Nacional Mariano Moreno (Argentina), in Spanish: Twain, Mark (000024237), the pseudonym Snodgrass, Quintus Curtius (000034486), Clemens, Samuel Langhorne (000034487) and the pseudonym Conte, Louis de (000034488). Each record has a VIAF link, places, field, occupation, sex, language, see-also links and sources. The source notes contain the typo 'Ciemens'.

Dictionary of Sydney (archived 2021) person entity 'Twain, Mark': one-line description, birth/death milestones, birth name, occupation, a 'Visitor 1895' role, and links to entries that mention him and subject tags.

The r/MarkTwain subreddit front page: a community discussion feed about Mark Twain, with user posts, ads and sidebar. It has no structured record. The only facts are the subreddit's own metadata and work titles named in post flairs and polls.

Biodiversity Heritage Library creator page for 'Clemens, Samuel Langhorne, 1835-1910': one digitized book plus an 'Author Details' box with name form, dates and external identifiers (LCCN, SNAK ARK, VIAF, Wikidata). Identifiers are given as bare ids, not URIs.

Kendtes Gravsted (Danish famous-graves site) person page for Mark Twain: birth name, dates and places with weekdays, a Danish mini-biography, and a 2019 grave photo caption (Woodlawn Cemetery, Elmira) credited to Wikipedia / Kenneth C. Zirkel.

The Online Books Page author listing 'Online Books by Mark Twain (Twain, Mark, 1835-1910)': a long list of freely readable editions (Gutenberg, archive.org, HathiTrust) in a curated section followed by 'Additional books from the extended shelves'. No biography; mentions a cross-reference heading and that a Wikipedia article exists, but the page text shows no URLs. Read via grep/sections (file ~108 KB).

Brockhaus article 'Mark Twain' (rendered in English, apparently machine-translated) showing only the free teaser: header line with real name, dates and places plus one sentence; the rest is behind a subscription ('Try it for free'). The 'Also interesting' sidebar lists other people (Wolfe, Brooks, Leacock, Warner, Doyle...) which is chrome; only the three Twain novel entries are kept as works.

SFE entry 'Twain, Mark' (updated 13 October 2025, tagged Author): long critical essay on his sf/fantastic work, a birth/death block, and a selected bibliography plus an 'about the author' list. Outbound links (Mark Twain House, ISFDB, Gutenberg) are shown only as link text without URLs.

extraction_notes.notes: Archived BYU Mormon Literature & Creative Arts person page for Mark Twain: a short biography about his place in Mormon literature (Roughing It), an alias and a one-item work table. The single listed work (Huck Finn and Tom Sawyer among the Indians, 2003) is actually Lee Nelson's completion of Twain's unfinished sequel, credited to Twain as author.

Representative Poetry Online poet page 'Twain, Mark (1835 - 1910)': index of two poems, a short biography paragraph with reading list, and a facts table (names, dates, nationality, literary period, cause of death, burial place).

nooSFere (French SF bibliographic database) author page 'Mark TWAIN, États-Unis' with birth/death data, real name, external-resource link labels and a list of French editions with original titles. External resources are shown only as link labels (no URIs in the text).

Koha OPAC MARC view of the Angelicum (Pontifical University of St Thomas Aquinas) authority record 77895 for Twain, Mark, 1835-1910, with field labels in Italian; record is fully visible despite the login_wall_suspected status. Bitraga (Galician translation library) author record 246: name fields (with a misspelt real name 'Samoel Langhoine Clemens'), empty biography fields, and a list of original monographs with genre, language and year; the translations list is empty in the text.

Bangumi person page 'Mark Twain' with an infobox (names in Chinese/Japanese, gender, dates), a short bio and a list of anime/book entries he is credited on. The captured text is a garbled machine translation (Chinese/Japanese to English), so the bio is barely usable.

Wayback copy of the Krugosvet article 'TWAIN, MARK'. The captured text is partly machine-translated to English (first half) and partly still in Russian (second half); offers a biography, discussion of works, and a Russian-language bibliography.

A Google Search results page resolved from the Freebase kgmid /m/014635. It contains a Knowledge Graph panel for Mark Twain (born, died, full name, spouse, children, books, plays) plus web, social and video results. Only the knowledge panel and its book and play lists were extracted. Snippets from social media were ignored.

A Tiaki (Alexander Turnbull Library unpublished collections) name thesaurus entry for Twain, Mark, 1835-1910. It gives a non-preferred term, dates and a short biography, and lists 11 linked collection items where he is subject or contributor. Most of the page is the search form.
Alvin portal person record alvin-person:9458 'Twain, Mark, 1835-1910' with occupations, birth/death years, one alternative name, and 1 related resource; visible despite the login button.

Two Czech National Library AUT records in standard view: jn19981002263 'Twain, Mark, 1835-1910' (real name Clemens) and jn20000701083 for the pseudonym 'Conte, Louis de, 1835-1910', cross-linked via 'Viz též'. External links (Wikipedie, Wikidata, ISNI, abART) are shown as labels only, without URLs.

Wayback Machine copy of the PWN encyclopedia entry 'Twain Mark': full biographical article in Polish with dates, places, occupations and major works with Polish translation years, a bibliography item and a related entry 'Clemens Samuel Langhorne'. Page ends with a consent banner (chrome).

Aozora Bunko author page No. 1431, rendered machine-translated into English: name, pronunciation, romanization, birth and death dates, and five Japanese translations listed as works in progress, with their translators.

The author URL rendered LibraryThing's sign-in/marketing landing page (sign in or join, testimonials, recent activity by other users); no author record for Twain is shown. Login wall; nothing extracted.

Wayback copy of the jeugdliteratuur.org author page 'Mark Twain' (Dutch): only a small facts block (birth/death date, birthplace, nationality) plus link labels (bibliotheek.be, Boekenzoeker, University Virginia, Books and Writers...) without URLs; no bio text or bibliography captured.

Estonian biographical database ISIK record 289 'Clemens, Samuel' (heading under real name): years of birth/death (given as 1835-00-00 / 1910-00-00), field of activity, pseudonym Mark Twain with source notes, and two Estonian periodicals (Postimees 1893, Sakala Lisa 1888) where he was published.

Japan Media Arts Database person record C415004 'TwainMark' (individual) with an NDL authority link, birth/death years, update date and 5 related manga resources (Tom Sawyer adaptations, a manga of 'What Is Man?'). Region and language fields read Japan/Japanese, which look like record defaults rather than facts about him.

The page mainly offers a GND link and a long list of networked resources, such as Filmportal, Kalliope and the National Portrait Gallery, shown as labels without URLs.

Roglo (GeneWeb) genealogy person page: name and pseudonyms, birth/death/burial events with places, parents, spouse and children, grandparents, siblings, and a long French-language biographical note. Footer says it is a copy of the Roglo base captured 2026-10-02 and gives a CC 4.0 licence.

Croatian Encyclopedia (online edition) article 'TWAIN, Mark' with a header box (field, short description, birth/death) and a long biographical/critical paragraph listing major works with Croatian and English titles; ends with a citation line.
